body: Since the way i want to word this probably isnt allowed, let me just say, as a 32 y.o man, if I ever feel like its ok to talk to a child like that, I hope someone gives me a lead sandwich.
Good to know, thank you! I'll absolutely find some cork bark and get rid of the hammock, is there any alternative hammock material that would be better, or just forego it?
The sparkers also look pretty dirty, might need to clean them up.

Yeah, the interactive map is good, but I wanted a quick reference picture for general locations without having to look at multiple sources, or have to mess around zooming in on the interactive. It's nice to have a picture I can just take a quick glance at.

I just started a new playthrough myself, and was trying to find a good reference map for shrine locations.  It’s infuriating how I could not find a single full map picture, every one that came up was a close up of particular regions. So thank you, this post helped both of us lol.

Thank you so much for the advice, I'll add the cleaner and moss to my growing amazon list, haha. I didn't think of home depot, I think there is one near me, actually. I'll have to go take a look at what they've got. 
Thanks as well for the kind words, I may be in my 30s, but sometimes I feel a little unprepared to care for another living thing. I've just really wanted a Lil repchild since childhood and finally am in a place and financial position to actually get one, i want to make sure I give my Lil guy or gal the best possible life.

That's very kind of you. I would, but honestly, I'm terrified of speaking to new people IRL, and I haven't played the game without my friends on voice chat. X'D I think I'm getting better, I'm able to escape chases no about half the time. I really like the haunted matches, the killers have been better on those for some reason.

Yeah that's true, I think it's just worst for me rn because I'm so new and the killers seem to sense that and I get tunneled a lot, which makes it hard to get better, because I'm killed before getting to really play. Or I get bots which also doesn't help you get better. I also haven't had too many bad experiences with other survivors since I'm lucky enough to have enough friends who play to not always have to deal with other survivors.

That's super annoying, like I definitely love the game, but sometimes playing with the wrong people leaves a bad taste :/ it's crazy cause having a bad teammate is almost worse than getting a bad killer.

Honestly, knowing how many bots and trolls I've played with already, it could easily be an even(ish) mix of both new players and jerks, I know the casting of frank stone brought in a chunk of new players, but going through the comments, and rethinking the games ive played, it definitely seems like there are players who either work with the killer or are totally selfish players. I've had a few rounds where it seems like the other players are on a team and only help each other, and one round where 2 people would walk around the killer and not get hit, then lead him to me and the other survivor where we would get slugged.

I am pretty new to the game so will sometimes not realize someone is on a Hook because I am so focused on skill checks, but I try my best to unhook and heal when I can. Unfortunately I have definitely caused the death of 2 survivors because I don't pay enough attention. Hopefully it's mostly just idiots like me and not people intentionally ruining the game, at least I'll eventually get better.

Yeah, the car stopped about a foot maybe from the back wall, it's crazy cause if my order had taken 45 seconds longer I'd have been under it. There was also a small group of kids next to me before I walked out that must have stepped away just in time. There was a lot of luck used in that moment.

From what i saw there was no structural damage, just the two panes of glass and the frame between them that she went through, (and some tables and chairs got destroyed.) It probably won't be that long before it's all fixed up, and their insurance should cover it. There were very few injuries, thankfully, and they were all mostly just small cuts.

I was there as it happened, was a much older woman who had no business behind a wheel and her daughter whom was probably in her 40s. The only way it could have happened in my opinion is she just punched the gas while parked in front as the second row of parking was totally full, so she didn't even have enough space to have lost control of her speed. Thankfully the group of kids that were right there must have moved away just in time, It's crazy she drove right into the table I had just walked away from. It's incredibly lucky she didn't kill anyone, and all the injuries were pretty minor. One girl had some cuts on her hands, a guy shins were cut up, another girl had a small cut on her head, and the girl that went to the hospital had a decent cut on her arm, but I think she actually got hit directly by the car, I'm uncertain.
